intro: Keep your nights organized and stylish. The Lean bedside table, crafted in solid Acacia wood, offers a sturdy build, warm finish, and a handy surface to keep your essentials always within reach.

features.title: Made with durable Acacia wood
features.text: Built from solid Acacia wood, the table offers everyday strength and durability while adding a naturally warm touch to your bedroom.

features.title: Compact size, big utility
features.text: Its practical dimensions fit snugly beside your bed, giving you enough space to keep essentials without crowding your room.

features.title: Surface for your nightly must-haves
features.text: Place your phone, lamp, book, or glasses on the wide top surface, so everything you need at bedtime is close at hand.

features.title: Naturally beautiful wood grain
features.text: Acacia’s attractive grain pattern enhances the look of your room with a rich, timeless charm that never feels out of place.

features.title: Easy knockdown assembly
features.text: Designed with knockdown construction, the table is simple to set up or move, making it flexible to suit your space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
